Remark
[Global versus local Lipschitz constants] 1. apph:H.1\group Euclidean convexitySource: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0435 For a map between metric spaces one may ask when \[ \Lip (f)=\sup _{x}\dil _x(f). \] The equality is a global-geometric question; it holds for the real line and the intrinsic circle metric, but need not follow from local Lipschitz regularity alone.
